functions.name: sync_search_console
functions.title: Sync Google Search Console
functions.description: Pulls latest indexing state, impressions, clicks, and ranking positions from Google Search Console for tracked URLs. Call when you need current SEO performance data or to refresh GSC metrics.

action.description: Operation to perform: 'sync' (default, syncs tracked URLs), 'sync_one' (sync a single URL), 'list_sites' (list GSC properties), 'register_urls' (add new URLs to track).

url_target_id.description: Required when action is 'sync_one' — the ID of the UrlTarget to sync.

limit.description: Max URLs to sync in one batch. Defaults to 25.

days.description: Number of days of hourly data to pull. Defaults to 2.

gsc_property.description: Required when action is 'register_urls' — the GSC property string (e.g. sc-domain:example.com).

urls.description: Required when action is 'register_urls' — array of URLs to register for tracking.

client_id.description: Optional client ID when registering URLs.

functions.name: check_gsc_verification
functions.title: Check GSC Property Verification
functions.description: Checks verification status of all Google Search Console properties, identifies unverified or missing domains, and generates DNS TXT verification instructions. Call when you need to verify domain ownership in GSC.

action.description: Operation: 'check_all' (default, checks all domains), 'attempt_verification' (re-adds missing properties to GSC), 'submit_sitemaps' (submits sitemaps for verified properties).

functions.name: generate_ai_response
functions.title: Generate AI Response via Vercel Gateway
functions.description: Generates an AI/LLM response using the Vercel AI Gateway (OpenAI models), bypassing Base44 integration credits. Call when you need AI text generation, analysis, or structured data extraction.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the AI model.

system_prompt.description: Optional system prompt to set the AI's role or behavior.

response_json_schema.description: Optional JSON schema if you want a structured JSON response. The root must be an object type.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens in the response. Defaults to 4096.

functions.name: send_email_direct
functions.title: Send Email via Gmail
functions.description: Sends an email through the Gmail OAuth connector, bypassing Base44 SendEmail credits. Call when you need to send notifications, reports, or outreach emails.

html.description: HTML body of the email. Provide either html or text (or both for multipart).

text.description: Plain text body of the email. Provide either text or html (or both for multipart).

from_name.description: Optional sender display name. Defaults to 'SEO Generator'.

functions.name: discover_strategic_urls
functions.title: Discover Strategic URL Opportunities
functions.description: Finds and evaluates high-value URL patterns for lead-generation site building using AI and web research. Scores each URL on search volume, CPC, lead value, and estimated site value. Call when researching new niche opportunities.

niche.description: The industry/niche to analyze (e.g. plumbing, water damage, locksmith).

functions.name: generate_sales_pitch
functions.title: Generate Sales Pitch for URL Buyer
functions.description: Creates a full sales pitch document for selling a strategic URL/website to a potential buyer, including price evaluation and ROI projections. Call when pitching a site to a buyer prospect.

buyer_prospect_id.description: ID of an existing BuyerProspect to generate a pitch for. If provided, loads the prospect and its strategic URL.

strategic_url_id.description: ID of a StrategicUrl to pitch. Required if buyer_prospect_id is not provided.

company_name.description: Name of the target buyer company. Used when creating a new prospect.

domain.description: Domain of the target buyer company.

functions.name: audit_site
functions.title: Full Site Audit
functions.description: Runs a comprehensive site audit across 8 axes (Technical, Content, Structure, SEO, AEO, Conversion, Security, Authority) and returns a prioritized remediation plan. Call when you need a full SEO+AEO health check of a URL.

url.description: The full URL to audit (must include http:// or https://).

functions.name: scrape_url
functions.title: Scrape URL and Extract Data
functions.description: Scrapes a URL and extracts all structured data: SEO metadata, JSON-LD schema, content headings, links, images, contact info, and technical signals. Call when you need to analyze a page's content and structure.

url.description: The full URL to scrape (must include http:// or https://).

functions.name: capture_lead
functions.title: Capture a Lead
functions.description: Creates a Lead record from a form submission. No authentication required — designed for public lead forms. Call when a user submits their contact info for a service quote.

service_category.description: Type of service the lead is interested in.

message.description: Additional message or project details from the lead.

city.description: City where the lead is located.

state.description: State where the lead is located.

functions.name: generate_seo_content
functions.title: Generate SEO Content
functions.description: Generates optimized on-page content (meta title, meta description, H1, schema markup, opening paragraph, FAQ) for tracked URLs based on their target queries. Call when you need AI-generated content for SEO pages.

url.description: Specific URL to generate content for. If omitted, generates for the top priority URLs.

limit.description: Max URLs to generate content for when url is omitted. Defaults to 10.

functions.name: technical_seo_audit
functions.title: Technical SEO Audit
functions.description: Scans a URL for technical SEO issues: title, meta, canonical, OG tags, JSON-LD schema, H1s, image alt text, internal links, word count, robots.txt, sitemap.xml. Returns a score and prioritized issue list. Call for a focused technical SEO check.

url.description: The full URL to audit (must include http:// or https://).

functions.name: search_console_operations
functions.title: Google Search Console Operations
functions.description: Performs GSC operations: list sites, inspect a URL's indexing status, submit sitemaps, query search analytics. Call when you need direct GSC API access for a specific property.

url.description: Required for 'inspect' — the URL to inspect.

site_url.description: Required for 'inspect', 'submit_sitemap', 'search_analytics' — the GSC property URL (e.g. sc-domain:example.com).

sitemap_url.description: Required for 'submit_sitemap' — the sitemap URL to submit.

start_date.description: For 'search_analytics' — start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: For 'search_analytics' — end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

dimensions.description: For 'search_analytics' — dimensions to group by (e.g. ['query']). Defaults to ['query'].

functions.name: generate_industry_playbook
functions.title: Generate Industry Playbook
functions.description: Generates a comprehensive SEO/AEO industry playbook with competitor benchmarks, content gaps, authority gaps, and surface wins. Call when onboarding a new client or entering a new industry vertical.

industry.description: The industry to analyze (e.g. plumbing, HVAC, water damage restoration).

sub_industry.description: Optional sub-industry specialization (e.g. emergency plumbing, commercial HVAC).

client_id.description: Optional client ID to associate the playbook with.
